name: HB-2 LFS vLLM multi-server launch
purpose: Switch LFS acceleration from direct Transformers to a vLLM OpenAI-compatible backend on GPUs 0-3, using one vLLM server per GPU and high-concurrency multi-state LFS clients. This records launch/provenance only and draws no HB-2 conclusion.

code_added_used.change: Launches one vLLM OpenAI-compatible server per GPU on GPUs 0-3.
Runs multi-state LFS shards against multiple vLLM base URLs with high request-worker concurrency.
Detached/nohup wrapper for the vLLM multi-server LFS run.
Fixes NO_FRONTIER handling when current state has no legal actions but frontier remains, and records vLLM backend metadata correctly.

commands.purpose: Launch one vLLM server per GPU on GPUs 0-3.

headline.sanity_pilot: Fixed vLLM B*-only n=4 sanity pilot produced normal budget-exhausted/solved rows: sudoku 2/4 solved, graph_color 1/4 solved.
headline.launch: Formal LFS vLLM multi-server run launched under master pid 1337498.
headline.utilization: At launch, vLLM EngineCore processes on GPUs 0-3 showed about 99-100% utilization.
headline.separation: This backend writes to full_grid_n64_vllm_gpu0_3_multiserver and must not be merged with direct-Transformers roots.

gate_outcomes.number: B*-only n=4 sudoku+graph_color ran to normal statuses after NO_FRONTIER fix.
Formal LFS vLLM multi-server full grid started with 4 shards and high request concurrency.
No formal vLLM merged full-grid output exists yet.

decision.next_step_routing: Monitor vLLM LFS checkpoints and merged output. If stable and fast, decide whether to run ToT/RAP vLLM backend separately or use LFS vLLM as an interim external baseline read.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not contain HB-2 result curves and does not compare solve rates. It only records vLLM multi-server launch and sanity evidence.
honesty.backend_limit: vLLM continuous batching is a separate external-baseline backend and can change outputs relative to direct Transformers. It must be reported separately.
honesty.conclusion_policy: Only merged formal vLLM outputs from full_grid_n64_vllm_gpu0_3_multiserver are eligible for a vLLM-backend read; debug sanity pilots are not final evidence.
honesty.runtime_note: The previous direct-Transformers LFS x2 run was stopped after 328 checkpoint rows; those rows are retained as telemetry only.
